translations.en: In the name of God, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

chunks.arabic_text: إِعْلَمْ - أَيَّدَكَ اللَّهُ وَإِيَانَا - إِنِّي لَمَا وَقَفْتُ عَلَىٰ كِتَابِ (السَّيِّدِ الْمُعَظَّمِ الْأَعْظَمِ) السَّيِّدِ جَمَالِ الدِّينِ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ طَاوُوسٍ فِي الرِّجَالِ فَرَأَيْتُهُ مُشْتَمِلًا عَلَىٰ نَقْلِ مَا فِي كُتُبِ السَّلَفِ، وَقَدْ كُنْتُ رُزِقْتُ - بِحَمْدِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَىٰ - النَّافِعِ مِنْ تِلْكَ الْكُتُبِ، إِلَّا "كِتَابَ ابْنِ الْغَضَائِرِيِّ" فَإِنِّي مَا كُنْتُ سَمِعْتُ لَهُ وُجُودًا فِي زَمَانِنَا هَذَا، وَكَانَ كِتَابُ السَّيِّدِ هَذَا - بِخَطِّهِ الشَّرِيفِ - مُشْتَمِلًا عَلَيْهِ؛ فَحَدَانِيَ التَّبَرُّكُ بِهِ - مَعَ ظَنِّ الِانْتِفَاعِ بِكِتَابِ ابْنِ الْغَضَائِرِيِّ - أَنْ أَجْعَلَهُ مُنْفَرِدًا عَنْهُ. رَاجِيًا مِنَ اللَّهِ الْجَوَادِ الْوُصُولَ إِلَىٰ سَبِيلِ الرُّشَادِ.

translations.en: Know – may God support you and us – that when I looked closely at the book of (the honored esteemed sayyid) al-Sayyid Jamāl al-Dīn Aḥmad b. Ṭāwūs about rijāl, I saw that it included what has been narrated from the books of the Salaf. And I was provided – by the praise of God تعالى – service of those books except for the book of Ibn al-Ghaḍā’irī, for I had not heard of its existence in this time of ours. And this book of the Sayyid – by his noble handwriting – included it. So, I was urged to find blessing by it – with the reckoning of getting benefit from the book of Ibn al-Ghaḍā’irī - that I make a separate (volume) from it, hoping for access to the path of reason from God the generous.

en.summary: This introduction highlights the meticulous scholarly practice of preserving and isolating rare texts, specifically Ibn al-Ghaḍā’irī’s work on weak narrators, which was otherwise inaccessible to the author. By extracting it from al-Ṭāwūs’s manuscript, the author ensures the preservation of critical biographical data for hadith authentication, reflecting the Shia emphasis on precise narrator evaluation (ʿilm al-rijāl). This act of compilation underscores the continuity of scholarly transmission and the reverence for early authorities in establishing the reliability of Prophetic traditions.
en.seo_question: Why did the author of Kitab al-Du'afa create a separate volume for Ibn al-Ghaḍā'irri's work?

key_terms.ابْنُ الْغَضَائِرِيِّ: Ibn al-Ghaḍā’irī (a prominent Shia scholar of rijāl)
